description: This file implements a distributed benchmarking script for PyTorch, involving RPC and DDP. It defines a HybridModel class, training routines, and orchestrates distributed training across multiple nodes with parameter servers and trainers, including setup, execution, and benchmarking output.

classes.name: HybridModel
classes.description: A PyTorch neural network model combining dense and sparse parts, with distributed data parallelism and remote embedding tables.

methods.name: _retrieve_embedding_parameters
methods.description: Retrieves parameters from an embedding RRef as RRefs.

methods.name: _print_header
methods.description: Prints the header for benchmark output.

methods.name: _print_cont
methods.description: Prints a message without a newline, flushes output.

methods.name: _run_printable
methods.description: Executes a shell command, captures output, and deserializes it.

methods.name: _run_trainer
methods.description: Runs a training loop on a trainer node, performing forward and backward passes with distributed autograd.

methods.name: run_worker
methods.description: Initializes RPC and process groups, sets up parameter servers and trainers, and runs the distributed training process.
